Subject: SOC2 + pen test + DPA walkthrough — planning and slot options

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the quick reply on the intake form. FinVault is aiming to schedule a combined session to: (1) walk through SOC 2 scope & controls, (2) run a short alignment with our pen-test vendor on expected timelines and access, and (3) review DPA clauses relating to log retention and access controls.

We have a couple of constraints: our compliance lead (APAC-based) can only join after 22:00 PST some days, and the pen vendor prefers a single contiguous window rather than multiple short hops. Can Redwood accommodate an after-hours slot?

Here are three candidate windows (all PST):
- Tue 30 Nov — 19:00–20:30 (90 min)
- Wed 1 Dec — 18:00–19:30 (90 min)
- Wed 1 Dec — 22:00–23:30 (90 min, APAC-friendly)

Please let me know which of these you can support, and whether Redwood can provide a one-page evidence mapping ahead of the call (SOC2 snapshot) plus an ops bridge (Zoom) with an engineer on standby. We can loop in Legal if any DPA redlines come up.

Attendees from our side: Alex Greene (Compliance), Priya Nair (Security Ops), Michael Huang (Pen vendor).

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Greene
Head of Compliance, FinVault
alex.greene@finvault.com

Alex — thanks for the clear options. We can absolutely support an after-hours setup. Two quick notes: 1) we recommend a 90-minute session the first time to avoid rushing the pen vendor handoff; 2) we can provide a short SOC2 evidence mapping snapshot in advance (see attachment).

Of your three windows, we prefer Wed 1 Dec 22:00–23:30 PST to make sure APAC stakeholders are full participants. If that doesn't work for the pen vendor, our backup is Tue 30 Nov 19:00–20:30 PST.

Markus, Laura — can you confirm availability for the 1 Dec 22:00–23:30 PST slot and who will own the ops bridge and evidence walkthrough?

Alex — I attached a quick preflight checklist (PDF) and a mapping template we typically use. If you want, we can circulate a proposed agenda: 1) 10m intros & objectives, 2) 25m SOC2 scope + evidence map, 3) 30m pen vendor scope & access/questions, 4) 25m DPA/redline discussion + next steps.

If you confirm the 22:00 slot I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and the shared drive link.

Thanks,
Ben
